description:
Queue module + integration (port-map §5).

OctoPi.Agent.PendingMessageQueue:
- new(mode :: :one_at_a_time | :all, bound \\\\ 1_000)
- enqueue/2 returns {:ok, q} or {:error, :full}
- has_items?/1, drain/1 (per mode), clear/1

Loop integration:
- After turn_end, before next inner iteration → drain steering queue,
  convert to messages, inject into context. If nonempty, re-enter
  inner loop immediately.
- After inner would exit → drain follow-up queue. If nonempty, re-enter
  inner loop; else break and emit agent_end.
- follow_up/2 on an idle session enqueues but does not wake. Next
  prompt/continue picks it up.

Per-session mode setter (mirrors TS agent.steeringMode = "all"):
  OctoPi.Agent.set_queue_mode(pid, :steering | :follow_up, mode)

TDD:
- enqueue beyond bound → {:error, :full}
- drain with :one_at_a_time returns [msg], leaves rest
- drain with :all returns all, clears queue
- steer during tool exec: message lands in next LLM context
- follow_up during idle: does NOT re-invoke loop; next prompt drains
- two-back-to-back follow_ups with :all mode: both run in one continuation

Depends on z1d.3.
title: Steering + follow-up queues wired into loop drainage points
